# Rogue Intelligence Dog Training

> Veteran-owned dog training company based in Chandler, AZ, serving the greater
> Phoenix Valley (Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Phoenix). Offers Board & Train
> and one-on-one owner lesson programs built on three principles: consistency,
> leadership, and understanding — training for confidence, communication, and
> teamwork rather than just memorized commands.

## Programs
- Board & Train: 2-3 weeks (Basic Obedience) up to 6-8 weeks (Advanced
  Obedience), dog trains daily on-site, owner learns to maintain results.
- Owner Lessons: one-on-one sessions, 4-5 sessions (Basic) up to 10-12
  sessions (Advanced Obedience), handler trains alongside the dog from day one.
